title: The selective co-delivery repair bills 124 against 112
body:
## Summary
- Blocks 0, 3, 10 and 13 each contribute centre support 2, so the nominal sensitivity is `112 - 8 = 104`.
- The repair adds 5 rank units on each block. `104 + 20 = 124`, which is 12 above the baseline.
- Partial receipt only. No new kappa, and no column replay.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/codelivery-repair-bill/verify.py`
